user.title: Decision model
user.description: Each check sends one camera frame to the provider's decision model and asks whether the print has failed.

data_description.name: Used for the device and entity names, e.g. the printer's name.
data_description.provider: OpenRouter reaches about 30 decision models with one key. Google's free tier serves gemini-decision-1, but Google uses free-tier inputs, your camera frames, to improve its products. The OpenAI format also works with gateways such as Vercel AI Gateway via the base URL option.
data_description.model: Leave empty for the provider's default: google/gemini-decision-1 on OpenRouter, gemini-decision-1 on Google, gpt-6-luna on OpenAI.

printer.title: Printer
printer.description: Pick the printer's entities from its own integration (ha-bambulab, Moonraker, OctoPrint, PrusaLink, ...).

data.active_states: States that mean a print is running
data.paused_states: States that mean a print is paused

data_description.camera: A camera that shows the build plate.
data_description.print_status: Frames are only checked while this entity is in one of the states below.
data_description.active_states: For example running (Bambu Lab) or printing (Moonraker, PrusaLink, Creality, OctoPrint).
data_description.pause_button: Used for auto-pause and the Pause notification action.
data_description.resume_button: Used by the Resume and Continue notification actions.
data_description.stop_button: Used by the Stop notification action.
data_description.paused_states: While paused, checks stop but a detected failure and a snooze are kept. Any other state ends the print. For example pause (Bambu Lab) or paused (Moonraker, PrusaLink, Creality, OctoPrint).
data_description.stage: Optional. A sensor showing what the printer is doing right now, such as ha-bambulab's Current stage. Checks then skip levelling, heating, purging and filament changes, which look odd on camera but aren't failures.
data_description.stage_states: printing for ha-bambulab. If the stage sensor is unavailable, checks run anyway.
data_description.layer: Optional. The current layer number, such as ha-bambulab's Current layer. With it, each check also compares the frame with one from some layers earlier, to catch a part that stopped growing: a clog, a filament runout, or printing into air.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Change the provider, API key or printer entities. The frame history and options are kept.

reauth_confirm.description: The provider rejected the API key for {name}, so frames can't be checked. Enter a new key.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. The printer was reloaded with the new settings.
abort.reauth_successful: Saved. Checks will use the new key.

error.camera_taken: Another printer already uses this camera.

data_description.auto_pause: Off: you get a notification with Pause, Stop and Continue. On: the printer is paused first and the notification offers Resume and Stop. Needs a pause button.
data_description.notify_services: Notify services to send actionable notifications to, e.g. notify.mobile_app_your_phone. A persistent notification in Home Assistant is always created.
data_description.snooze_minutes: After you tap Continue or Resume, checks pause for this long so the same failure doesn't alert again right away.
data_description.print_report: When a watched print ends, send a summary of its checks with a strip of frames to the notify services above.

data.compare_layers: Compare frames this many layers apart

data_description.window: How many recent checked frames count toward a failure.
data_description.required: How many of those must show a failure before alerting.
data_description.yes_threshold: An answer above this counts as yes.
data_description.no_threshold: An answer below this counts as no. Frames in between are skipped.
data_description.interval: How often to check at the start of a print, when most failures begin.
data_description.early_minutes: How long the start of a print lasts, counted from when it starts printing (after the start routine with a stage sensor). 0 uses the later interval throughout.
data_description.later_interval: How often to check for the rest of the print.
data_description.compare_layers: Needs a layer sensor (Reconfigure). Each check also sends a frame from this many layers earlier, to catch a part that stopped growing. Enough layers for visible growth: 20 is about 4 mm at 0.2 mm layers. 0 turns it off.
data_description.daily_limit: Stops automatic checks for the rest of the day once this many model calls were made, with one notification. Check now still works. 0 means no limit.

data_description.save_frames: Saved frames appear in the Print failures panel. Every check's result is recorded either way, for the stats.
data_description.retention_days: Older frames and results are deleted every hour.
data_description.max_storage_mb: When saved frames exceed this, the oldest images are deleted first. Their results stay in the stats.

data_description.base_url: Empty uses the provider's API. Set it to send the provider's request format to a gateway or proxy.
data_description.camera_description: Sent with every frame. Describing your exact camera can help or hurt depending on the model; compare on your own prints.
data_description.max_image_size: Frames with a longer side are downscaled to this many pixels.
data_description.questions: Override, disable or add questions. See Customizing questions at https://github.com/somus/ha-print-failure-monitor/blob/main/docs/tuning.md for the format. Check your own prints after any change.

error.required_gt_window: Failed frames needed can't be more than frames to remember.
error.thresholds: The no threshold must be below the yes threshold.

options.openai: OpenAI format (OpenAI, Vercel AI Gateway, other gateways)

options.not_clean: Only frames that didn't look fine

check.name: Check now
check.description: Checks a camera frame right away and returns the result and every question's probability. During a print, a check of the printer's own camera counts toward the failure window like a scheduled one.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: The monitored printer whose settings, model and API key are used.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Check this camera instead of the printer's. The result is only returned: it doesn't change the printer's entities, window or history.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Clears a detected failure and skips checks for a while, like the Continue button on a notification. Snoozing ends when the print does.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: The monitored printer whose settings, model and API key are used.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to snooze. Defaults to the snooze option. 0 ends a snooze and checks right away.

checks_failing.title: {printer} isn't being watched for failures
checks_failing.description:
The last {checks} checks of {printer} failed, so failures during this print can't be detected.

Last error: {error}

If the error is about the camera, check that {camera} shows a picture: the printer may be offline, or for a Bambu Lab printer, LAN mode liveview may be off. Otherwise the model provider may be down or rejecting requests.

This goes away on its own once a check works again or the print ends.
